# pve_subscription (Resource)

Node subscription key: set via PUT, checked via the API, removable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_subscription" "example" {
  key  = "CHANGE_ME"
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Proxmox VE subscription key
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `checktime` (Number) Timestamp of the last check done.
- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node (also the `terraform import` format).
- `level` (String) A short code for the subscription level.
- `message` (String) A more human readable status message.
- `nextduedate` (String) Next due date of the set subscription.
- `productname` (String) Human readable productname of the set subscription.
- `regdate` (String) Register date of the set subscription.
- `serverid` (String) The server ID, if permitted to access.
- `signature` (String) Signature for offline keys
- `sockets` (Number) The number of sockets for this host.
- `status` (String) The current subscription status.
- `url` (String) URL to the web shop.
